name: hf_kits23
title: KiTS23: 489 kidney-tumour CTs with kidney, tumour and cyst labels
description: The 2023 Kidney and Kidney Tumor Segmentation challenge imaging as published by the organisers on the Hub: contrast-enhanced abdominal CT per case (100-280 MB) with a three-class label map. Two scoped folders of the repo are listed (images, segmentations).

license.note: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 on the Hub card (checked 2026-10-14): non-commercial, share-alike.

citation: Heller N., Isensee F., Trofimova D., et al. The KiTS21 Challenge: Automatic segmentation of kidneys, renal tumors, and renal cysts in corticomedullary-phase CT. arXiv:2307.01984, 2023.
